spots.name: Amarillo Continuo
tags: artist: Manuel de la Cruz González
spots.blurb: You've reached Amarillo Continuo, a mural by Manuel de la Cruz González. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.
